evidence.explanation: The only which_armor marker is the invalid hero armor-slot diagnostic. This exact caller supplies a fixed valid helmet/glove slot, so the marker is unreachable even if the hero branch were selected.
evidence.proof: Complete helper pin, exact single caller argument, frozen slot table membership and C/JS mask values are checked by proof.mjs. Compiled complete C helper and actual JS helper agree for present/missing helmet and gloves. Pure lookup input records do not certify equipment or combat transitions.
